job_name: kit/emit_custody.py resolves predicate.specVersion from the custody document it attests, or refuses

job_to_be_done.desired_future: An emitter run against a checkout whose SPEC.md declares 0.9.9 emits a record that says 0.9.9 and names the SPEC.md it read by digest; with no document and no override it exits 3 naming spec-version and writes no record; --spec-version is honoured and the record says so; no published verdict moves.
gains: The emitted record's specVersion can be trusted against the document it claims to attest.
The re-pin's property and the emitter's property agree, so the two instruments no longer disagree on how the version is resolved.
pain_points: A record that attests a document and stamps a different version is a self-contradiction the document itself rejects.
The defect sits on two paths (:594 and :1179) that each stamp the literal separately, so a fix that teaches one path leaves the other red.
There is no refusal path: an unreadable or absent document must not fall back to the override or to the literal.
job_to_be_done.statement: kit/emit_custody.py must stamp predicate.specVersion with the version the custody document the job attests declares. At base 8590496 kit/emit_custody.py:88 holds SPEC_VERSION = "0.9.8" — a literal — and both paths that write a record stamp it (:594 round, :1179 inputs). With no resolution and no refusal, a job that attests custody at any other version emits a record the document refuses (custody/tools/count.py:153-161), and the emitter cannot notice: it never reads a document in order to say what version it attests. The fix confines itself to how the emitter resolves its spec version; --spec-version stays as an explicit override.

threshold_mapping: Binary scale per dimension: 1 = the check PASSes, 0 = it does not. pass = mean >= T_accept(1) AND min >= T_dim(1), i.e. every check PASS. Any 0 with iterations < cap -> regenerate; at cap -> needs_owner. T_reject 0 means the algebra never rejects. k = 2 iteration bound (= cap); x = 10 (% of budget) B.1.2 discovery window; x is NOT a spend allowance — the budget stays strictly < US$0.25.
